Selected work

A few things I’ve designed, built and shipped.

GitHub App · Backend

PR-Lens Bot (glint)

A webhook-driven GitHub App that triages pull requests. It fetches the diff and posts a structured review with GREEN, YELLOW or RED tiers, labels and email alerts. Rule-based checks (secret detection, diff shape, account age) are combined with LLM code review, and webhooks are secured with HMAC signature verification.

PrepHub

A campus placement preparation platform with student login, aptitude tests, technical MCQs and coding practice. It has an online code compiler, an AI doubt-solving assistant, company-wise preparation and core subject modules (DSA, OOP, DBMS, Networks, OS). Live and usable on any device.
